environment: Shared Linux host, headless mobile emulation with touch and DPR 2. Geometry, seating and timing jobs were running concurrently. These durations describe the local verifier.

attempts.outcome: Reached the ready, painted 28-resident home in 44.27 seconds in an exploratory run and in 125.93 seconds in the complete shell suite.
Two cold loads reached the painted native home in 134.29 and 138.89 seconds. The family, region, time, curve, variant and mobile control state matched the requested defaults.
